_comment: A flat corridor of standard gates (E17, M7): four gates 160 px apart whose gap is centred on the bird's start height (320 / 598 of the playable height, so the gap top rounds to 256 px - exactly FixedSpawnTable.CENTRED_TOP). Streamed as a forced pattern it places every gate where the fixed table would; PatternStreamerTest proves it tick for tick.
